prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1279; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim processing. Can you please state your full name for the record?

A: Sure. I'd rather keep my name off the recording if that's okay, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit.

Q: Understood. Can you describe what happened on the day of the accident?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Sugar Land, in the right lane. The traffic was pretty heavy. The light turned green, the car ahead of me started moving, and then I felt a hard jolt from behind. The other driver hadn't stopped in time.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only in the mirror for a second. It looked like it was coming in pretty fast. I didn't have time to react.

Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?

A: No. The rear bumper was crushed and the trunk wouldn't close properly, so a tow truck took it.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention?

A: Yes. I went to the emergency room later that afternoon. My left wrist was really swollen and painful. They did X-rays and told me it was fractured. I'm in a cast now and I have a follow-up with a specialist next week.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes, especially when I try to grip something or turn a doorknob. I've been told I may need physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?

A: Only that I've been keeping my receipts and medical bills, and I can send them to you. I just want this handled properly.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing about the next steps.
